response.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration), COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: replacement_cost cutoff of 20.99 means replacement_cost >= 20.99 (films at or above the threshold). A cutoff could also mean the opposite (values ≤ 20.99).

alternatives.interpretation: replacement_cost cutoff of 20.99 interpreted as an upper bound: keep films with replacement_cost ≤ 20.99
alternatives.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration), COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10;
